observation: The nine-decimal exported baseline target line exceeded the exact 4/2/4 m/s^2 calculations by up to about 3.1e-8 m/s^2 when reloaded, although the unrounded profile sat on the boundary. The first offline-line check therefore reported the baseline as ineligible.
resolution: offline_line_protocol.json registers a 1e-7 m/s^2 numerical serialization tolerance; map footprint, curvature, closure and all physical target limits are unchanged. All three saved candidate files are reloaded and checked under that rule before any optimization run.
source_failure_remains: The published MapZoo speed schedule exceeds the registered limits by whole m/s^2 and remains ineligible.
